**2-VECTOR SPACES AND GROUPOIDS JEFFREY C. MORTON**

44 pp, 19 sections.

**Abstract.** This paper describes a relationship between essentially ﬁn ite groupoids and 2-vector spaces. In particular, we show to construct 2-v ector spaces of V ect-valued presheaves on such groupoids. W e deﬁne 2-linear maps corre- sponding to functors between groupoids in both a covariant a nd contravariant way, which are ambidextrous adjoints. This is used to constr uct a representation— a weak functor—from Span( FinGpd) (the bicategory of essentially ﬁnite groupoids and spans of groupoids) into 2V ect. In this paper we prove this and give the construction in detail.
